projectDescription: An internal suite of tools for Luxurique staff to build, manage, and export luxury travel quotations — covering the QC Sheet (Excel workbook), QC Webapp (web replacement), and the surrounding CRM and analytics stack.
keyFeatures: Multi-tab quotation and costing workbook (up to 30 quote sets per QC)
Category and label-based markup engine with per-QC rate overrides
Group and section organisation for structuring cost line items
Branded PDF, Word, and XLSX quotation export (Luxurique, Luxurique Travel, Liberty brands)
DailyView aggregated read-only summary across all active MainTables
QC Webapp: React SPA with Supabase backend, real-time collaboration, and undo/redo
Role-based access control (Project Lead, Sales Lead, Supervisor, Admin)
Microsoft Entra ID (M365) single sign-on for the webapp
Audit log and full change history with operation-level undo
Twenty CRM integration for deal linking and GRANDTOTAL push
n8n email triage and CRM upsert workflows
Preset.io (Apache Superset) BI dashboards over Supabase analytics
Vero email marketing integration with Supabase relay
publicApiSurface: QC Sheet Ribbon: Export PDF (A4/A3), Export Word, Export XLSX, Update Quotation, Template selector
QC Sheet Ribbon: Add Tab, Delete Quote Set
QC Webapp: supabase-js client connecting to Postgres via RLS
QC Webapp RPCs: cell_edit, row_insert, row_delete, bulk_edit, paste_clone, move, section_op, tab_op, group_op, quote_op, concession_set
QC Webapp: Supabase Auth signInWithOAuth (Microsoft Entra ID)
Supabase Edge Function: twenty-webhook (HMAC-verified webhook ingestion)
Supabase Edge Function: vero-push (marketing sync to Vero)
Supabase Edge Function: vero-webhook / vero-processor (Vero → Twenty relay)
